name: NDMA Data Centre Department / government data centre
developer: National Data Management Authority (Government of Guyana)
notes: Guyana Chronicle reports NDMA's Data Centre Department as a key part of government ICT services and describes an operational data centre supporting network infrastructure; Govportal lists NDMA in Queenstown, Georgetown, Demerara-Mahaica. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Berbice Region Six AI data centre
notes: President Ali announced an AI data center for Region Six/New Amsterdam area, to be powered by Guyana's second gas development; later Berbice Development Summit coverage described advanced data centres among planned Berbice investments with groundwork expected by 2028. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Cerebras / Government of Guyana Wales AI Data Center
developer: Cerebras Systems and Government of Guyana
notes: Cerebras and Guyana signed an MoU to build and operate an AI data center of up to 100 MW in Wales, near the Gas-to-Energy plant on the West Bank of Demerara; 2026 local coverage continued to describe the Region Three facility as planned pending the Wales energy project.
